images.self_review: Preserves field, off-centre trees and small sun. Painted cloud detail is more pronounced than source; accepted as poetic interpretation.
Palm contact and flower silhouette retained; natural creases and partial fingers visible. Florets remain fairly detailed, accepted for close-view intimacy.
Source tree, trunk wrap, traffic, cabin, car and yellow figure retained in wide painted interpretation. No claim of documentary fidelity.
Calmer sky and smaller/lower flower, original mood retained. Flower still appears somewhat posed; study only.
Cream flower and laterite rainwater retained; soft edges and calm upper area support masthead. Recommended study; not selected for edition replacement.
